macros.name: glossglue
macros.doc: The inter-word spacing in gloss blocks is controlled by the skip register \glossglue, whose default value is 5pt plus 2pt minus 1pt.

macros.name: glt
macros.doc: \glt closes the aligned gloss block and introduces a free translation.

envs.name: example
envs.doc: The example environment is like shortexample except that the label appears on a separate line above the example content, separated by a small vertical skip.

envs.name: shortexample
envs.doc: The shortexample environment produces a numbered example whose optional label appears on the same line as the number.

envs.name: unlabeledexample
envs.doc: The unlabeledexample environment produces a numbered example with no label.
